verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents official Python and TypeScript SDK references, and its SDKs index says they can log traces from code. For Python, `wrap_openai` automatically logs LLM calls. The JS/TS evidence (official SDK repo and TypeScript reference) shows only eval APIs, not tracing or instrumentation in a JS/TS app, so instrumentation in both languages is only partly evidenced. missing for 10: explicit JS/TS tracing/instrumentation documentation (e.g., wrappers or span APIs), independent or hands-on corroboration of instrumenting apps in both languages.

support.subject: As a developer, I can instrument apps in both Python and JS/TS with officially supported SDKs

citations.quote: Log traces, manage prompts, create datasets, and run evals or experiments right from your code.
Braintrust provides `wrap_openai`, a drop-in wrapper around the OpenAI client that automatically logs all LLM calls to Braintrust.
A function you can use to define an evaluator. This is a convenience wrapper around the `Evaluator` class.
Create an Eval scorer that will evaluate an agent based on assertions on the generated trace.
Add tracing to your AI application to capture LLM calls, application logic, and user feedback
